coordinate_space: image (captured raster pixels; origin top-left, +u right, +v down)

conventions.edge_direction: j -> i: source j (neighbour) to destination i (target); edge_index[0] = source node, edge_index[1] = destination node
conventions.heading: image-plane radians from +u toward +v (clockwise on screen), range [-pi, pi)
conventions.relative_bearing: relative to the destination agent's heading
conventions.closing_rate: positive when image-plane separation shrinks; not road-relative closing speed
conventions.missing_values: NaN in float arrays, with a False entry in the parallel boolean mask array
conventions.edge_order: per relation: frame ascending, then destination node index, then source node index
conventions.node_order: frame ascending, then canonical (natural) track order

node_features.coordinate_space: image (captured raster pixels; origin top-left, +u right, +v down)

node_features.name: v_px

node_features.coordinate_space: image (captured raster pixels; origin top-left, +u right, +v down)

node_features.coordinate_space: image (captured raster pixels; origin top-left, +u right, +v down)

node_features.name: heading_cos
node_features.coordinate_space: image (captured raster pixels; origin top-left, +u right, +v down)

node_boxes.coordinate_space: image (captured raster pixels; origin top-left, +u right, +v down)

node_boxes.name: box_y_min_px
node_boxes.formula: Phase 3 bbox_xyxy column joined through source_line
node_boxes.coordinate_space: image (captured raster pixels; origin top-left, +u right, +v down)

node_boxes.name: box_x_max_px
node_boxes.formula: Phase 3 bbox_xyxy column joined through source_line
node_boxes.coordinate_space: image (captured raster pixels; origin top-left, +u right, +v down)

node_boxes.name: box_y_max_px
node_boxes.formula: Phase 3 bbox_xyxy column joined through source_line
node_boxes.coordinate_space: image (captured raster pixels; origin top-left, +u right, +v down)

edge_features.name: du_px
edge_features.coordinate_space: image (captured raster pixels; origin top-left, +u right, +v down)

edge_features.name: dv_px
edge_features.coordinate_space: image (captured raster pixels; origin top-left, +u right, +v down)

edge_features.name: sep_px
edge_features.formula: sqrt(du^2 + dv^2): image-plane pixel separation, NOT a physical distance
edge_features.coordinate_space: image (captured raster pixels; origin top-left, +u right, +v down)

edge_features.name: bearing_sin
edge_features.coordinate_space: image (captured raster pixels; origin top-left, +u right, +v down)

edge_features.name: bearing_cos
edge_features.coordinate_space: image (captured raster pixels; origin top-left, +u right, +v down)

edge_features.name: rel_bearing_sin
edge_features.formula: sin(bearing - heading_i) using the DESTINATION heading
edge_features.coordinate_space: image (captured raster pixels; origin top-left, +u right, +v down)
edge_features.missing_reason: zero separation or destination heading unavailable

edge_features.name: rel_bearing_cos
edge_features.coordinate_space: image (captured raster pixels; origin top-left, +u right, +v down)
edge_features.missing_reason: zero separation or destination heading unavailable

edge_features.name: sep_over_h
edge_features.formula: sep_px / max(box_h_j, box_h_i): heuristic depth-normalised proximity, not calibrated
edge_features.coordinate_space: image (captured raster pixels; origin top-left, +u right, +v down)

edge_features.name: log_h_ratio
edge_features.formula: ln(box_h_j / box_h_i): heuristic relative-scale proxy, not calibrated depth
edge_features.coordinate_space: image (captured raster pixels; origin top-left, +u right, +v down)

edge_features.name: dv_row_px
edge_features.formula: v_j - v_i (footpoint row difference; depth-order heuristic only under a flat road below the horizon). Numerically identical to dv_px by definition; kept as specified in the design
edge_features.coordinate_space: image (captured raster pixels; origin top-left, +u right, +v down)

edge_features.name: dvel_u_px_s
edge_features.formula: vel_u_j - vel_u_i: relative IMAGE velocity (includes perspective and ego-motion parallax), not physical relative velocity
edge_features.coordinate_space: image (captured raster pixels; origin top-left, +u right, +v down)

edge_features.name: dvel_v_px_s
edge_features.coordinate_space: image (captured raster pixels; origin top-left, +u right, +v down)

edge_features.name: closing_rate_px_s
edge_features.formula: -(du*dvel_u + dv*dvel_v) / sep_px = -d(sep_px)/dt; positive = image-plane separation shrinking. Rate of change of PIXEL separation, not road-relative closing speed
edge_features.coordinate_space: image (captured raster pixels; origin top-left, +u right, +v down)
edge_features.missing_reason: either velocity unavailable or zero separation

edge_features.name: overlap_ios
edge_features.formula: intersection area / smaller box area (boxes j and i); occlusion indicator
edge_features.coordinate_space: image (captured raster pixels; origin top-left, +u right, +v down)

edge_flags.name: scale_truncation_affected
edge_flags.definition: either endpoint inherits Task 2 bbox_touches_border = true (box within 1 px of the image border): POSSIBLE truncation affecting box-height-based features; not confirmed truncation

edge_flags.name: sep_over_h_le_2
edge_flags.definition: sep_over_h <= 2; exploratory sensitivity flag, not a validated threshold; never removes an edge

edge_flags.name: sep_over_h_le_5
edge_flags.definition: sep_over_h <= 5; exploratory sensitivity flag, not a validated threshold; never removes an edge

edge_flags.name: sep_over_h_le_10
edge_flags.definition: sep_over_h <= 10; exploratory sensitivity flag, not a validated threshold; never removes an edge

edge_flags.name: knn_4
edge_flags.definition: source is among the 4 nearest incoming candidates of the destination across all enabled relations, ranked by (sep_over_h, sep_px, source canonical track order); exploratory; never removes an edge

edge_flags.name: knn_8
edge_flags.definition: source is among the 8 nearest incoming candidates of the destination across all enabled relations, ranked by (sep_over_h, sep_px, source canonical track order); exploratory; never removes an edge

excluded.acceleration: excluded from default node features (decision A1: frame-to-frame raw acceleration dominated by non-smooth components)
excluded.same_track_family: reserved in the design table and always false in Task 3 (fragments are never linked); not stored because it carries no information
excluded.uncertainty_features: none in the default representation (Q8); see diagnostics.uncertainty
excluded.world_coordinates: never produced; world_x/world_y null and world_position_valid false upstream
